title: I need 12 Brawl Stars players to help get my app on Google Play
description:
I need 12 Brawl Stars players to help get BrawlZone Bubble onto Google Play 🙏 Google only publishes a new app after 12 testers keep it for 14 days.

👉 brawlzone.net/bubble/test (3 taps) or DM me "BUBBLE" and I'll send you the links.
